What's a spicule?

Spicules go on first, so your cream or mask sinks in deeper.

What it isTiny spicules in a watery serum.Smaller than your pores, so they get right in.
OvernightYour cream or mask sinks in deeper.You get more out of them by morning.
The tingleA light tingle is normal.That's the spicules working while you pat.
After thatGone in 72 hours.They shed on their own.

For you to know. Don't explain any of this in your video.
